SYNCME CONTINUATION MASTER — 2026-10-08
Repository: https://github.com/DrEsmaily/element-x-android
Main branch: syncme-main
Last confirmed successful SyncMe build prior to current batch: #77, SHA 79cc969595a26bbf4e8aa1919213a4d83512b293.
Source is a fork of element-hq/element-x-android. Release is :app:assembleGplayRelease with package suffix .syncmerelease.
This document specifies intended behavior; commit log shows implementation, and a successful APK build alone does not verify runtime behavior.

RESOLVED NETWORK SPEED MISDIAGNOSIS
The approximately 10x upload speed difference versus Google Play was caused by different VPN routing: Play bypassed VPN, self-built APKs used VPN. With VPN disabled, clean upstream build uploaded quickly. Do not change Matrix Rust SDK purely to fix this speed discrepancy.

P0 UPLOAD RELIABILITY — NOT YET VERIFIED FIXED
Observed: large file upload stalls midstream, reverts from around 88% to 12%, loops/retries unexpectedly and sometimes never completes, while data transfers. Differentiate retry of same Matrix transaction from multiple enqueued local echoes. Diagnose Matrix send-queue lifecycle and HTTP upload attempts; avoid unlimited automatic retry and misleading jumps. Preserve data integrity; cancellation must cancel actual queued send, not just dismiss UI. Investigate messages behind a stalled upload in queue. Repeated upload UI events now have an active-job guard, but SDK stall/retry loop is NOT proven fixed. Upstream sending path restored; duplicate progress collectors removed. Need controlled on-device testing, logs, and retry-attempt evidence.

UPLOAD PROGRESS UI
Use SDK LocalEventSendState.Sending.MediaWithProgress as source; accurate percentage and bytes, no false 1B/100% or forced minimum 1%. Progress track should begin and end exactly at file/video bubble edges (including alignment/constraints), thickness stays 3dp. Retry, stall, cancel should be clearly represented. Do not silently reset high % to low %. Bubble sizing should not break with two lines of emojis; avoid extra width for short text.

NAVIGATION / PERFORMANCE
Latest user feedback: 150ms chat fade feels sluggish/laggy despite faster navigation. Room-specific fader shortened to 90ms (commit 5191fafe); menu/other slides remain 150ms. Must test frame pacing and perceived opening speed on device; if lag persists profile RoomFlowNode/JoinedRoomFlowNode composition, not merely shorten animation again.
Open a chat as promptly and smoothly as Settings/Menu. General screen transitions tween(150ms); room navigation now fast 150ms fade instead of slide. HomeFlowNode guards getJoinedRoom with 50ms timeout then navigates. Confirm RoomFlowNode / JoinedRoomFlowNode initial shell and loading are not perceived as extra lag; test warm/cold room opening and return transitions on device. Release build with R8 optimization, not Debug.

LONG PRESS / CANCEL / SHEETS
During active media send, present explicit Cancel upload instead of ambiguous Remove; route through Matrix send-queue cancellation. Long-press bottom sheet must fully clear Android navigation bar and last destructive action remain touchable. Ensure true OLED black modal background/scrim behavior and media viewer background (#000000), without unwanted gray overlay.

HOME / TAGS / BRAND
Spaces navigation, buttons, page and create-space UI hidden, keep underlying Matrix Spaces capability. Chats-only main screen; standard bottom-end FAB (+) on right, not centered. Title SyncMe. Preserve Unread, People, Rooms, Favorites filters. Add persistent custom multi-room tags (create/delete, multi-tag per chat, persistent active selection until manually cleared, auto-fallback to All when active tag deleted), horizontal chips, context-menu assignment, storage in preferences/DataStore. Keep Deep Cobalt accents and black theme; prior palette, moderation/safety placement and red indicator choices.
First-run homeserver syncme.ir. Developer Options hidden normally, unlock by five taps on app version. Media send choice Original / Compressed with specs; remove duplicate Media Upload Quality setting. Preserve agreed defaults.

BUILD / VERIFICATION
Prior #78 and subsequent builds had Kotlin errors; compile success and on-device verification are separate. CI run is authoritative for exact SHA and artifacts. Keep checkpoint TXT in same GitHub Actions artifact as APK, including SHA, run, full git log and changed paths; on failure publish TXT alone. For continuing conversation: read newest checkpoint, inspect GitHub run, compare against #77 and latest upstream, fix build failures, test upload lifecycle first, then room opening and UI, report honestly. Never claim fully fixed without evidence.

2026-10-08 LATEST UPLOAD DEBUGGING:
User confirms Google Play version handles >200 MB reliably while SyncMe upload can take long to show local echo/progress, appear to reach 100% then fall back and retry, and cancellation is delayed. This must be treated as a regression relative to production Google Play, subject to same VPN routing, server, and file tests.
Commit 2ea93bb tracked the actual sessionMediaSendJob (not merely the short-lived preview coroutine), preventing duplicate button events from creating concurrent sends during a still active upload. Commit 799f13b cancels preparatory processing on CancelAndClearSendState. Neither demonstrates the cause of internal HTTP retry or fixes progress regression after 100%. SDK versions differ and must be compared/tested before claiming parity with Play. The upstream DefaultMediaSender matches tag v26.09.4 at source; app-level sending UI differs. This is NOT verified as fixed. Produce optimized GplayRelease with checkpoint; run 200+MB upload and cancel scenarios on device.

2026-10-08 USER VALIDATION (LATEST SCREENSHOTS)
A real 226.5 MB ZIP shows Uploading 29% (66.0 MB/226.5 MB). User reports repeated rollback/retry with no successful completion, lag before local echo and progress, and cancellation delay; Google Play production client reportedly uploads the same scale reliably. UI bottom action sheet exposes only some actions and stops partially expanded, with actions below viewport. The previous builds compiled but did not solve these runtime issues. Commit e02c49f forces message action sheet to expand beyond partial anchor, untested on device. Do not claim upload loop fixed. Need reproduce while collecting SDK log timestamps, HTTP upload status, transaction ID and retry attempt lifecycle; compare VPN conditions and app SDK versions. User says exact same original client works. Further action should be guided by evidence, not visual progress hacks.

2026-10-08 UPSTREAM ROLLBACK EXPERIMENT: User cannot supply ADB logs and observes Play client works. Commit 7fefb4b restores AttachmentsPreviewPresenter.SendAttachment coroutine/job lifecycle to benchmark-elementx-v26-09-4 baseline while retaining SyncMe video quality selector choices. Previous custom tracking jobs and duplicate-tap guard in preview were removed for parity. This is an A/B diagnosis experiment, NOT proof of fix. SDK still differs: SyncMe 26.10.05-nightly vs reference 26.09.26. When comparing, use same VPN routing, server, exact file and device. Do not conflate compile success with upload reliability.

2026-10-08 NEW ON-DEVICE EVIDENCE: Same custom Nightly-based client completes large upload without VPN; under VPN it repeatedly resets/fails. Play client succeeds. Investigate VPN split tunneling (Play bypass vs SyncMe routed), MTU/fragmentation, long-lived upload HTTP connection resets/timeouts, app-specific VPN routing, and Nightly Rust SDK retry handling. Do not conclude SDK regression without same-tunnel A/B. UI screenshot confirms local video top/bottom bars gray: actual MediaVideoView used ElementTheme.colors.bgSubtlePrimary, changed to Color.Black in commit b8ae329. Long-press sheet and truncated progress line remain unresolved after previous attempts; do not claim fixed.

2026-10-08 UI-ONLY RELEASE CHECKPOINT: User explicitly requested pause VPN/network/SDK diagnostics until UI is corrected and APK built. Commit 160d3fe caps message action list height relative to screen and preserves scroll so bottom options should be reachable. Commits 06981ea and 9e7eae allow upload file bubbles to widen to 300dp (or fit narrow screen) and align progress track; keep one-line status. These are code fixes, not yet on-device validated, and don't address actual upload retry under VPN. Next check GplayRelease build, inspect compilation and artifact, then user test black playback, scrolling bottom menu, and full upload status text.

2026-10-08 LATEST THREE UI REGRESSIONS / PATCHES:
User-tested screenshot shows fixed 300dp uploadBubbleMinWidth caused video to widen excessively, the text below was still the source of unwanted layout. Commit 291b4f changes minimum width to a measure of the ACTUAL one-line status text, clamped to available display width, rather than fixed 300dp. Must test small/large files and videos in landscape/portrait.
Long-press action modal moved from fully expanded to partially expanded on first Back, then dismissed on second Back. Commit ce10d60 uses SheetState.confirmValueChange to disallow PartiallyExpanded, permitting one-step dismissal; requires release compile and device test.
Custom tag chip selection previously incremented scrollToStart and ran repeated per-pixel spring scroll loops toward index zero. Commit d8aea86 instead animates directly to the chosen tag index and animates chip items. Verify leading-edge behavior in both RTL/LTR and new tag creation.
These are UI-only, VPN/network logic untouched. Track latest build/run and verify APK + per-build checkpoint; do not claim on-device success before validation.

2026-10-08 UI REGRESSION FOLLOW-UP (LATEST): User reports previous attempted fixes still wrong. Required invariant: natural file/video bubble width first; progress track = bubble width; only when actual full one-line upload status requires more width, expand bubble minimally to that measured text width, never force fullscreen. Current experimental code measures status, captures actual bubble width, applies widthIn only if smaller; commit 5c97f156; needs on-device verification, especially video. Custom tags must behave like built-in filters: selected tag becomes leftmost of custom group, scroll to that position without rewind; commit 591a903. Bottom sheet must open fully and single Back immediately dismiss; switched to rememberModalBottomSheetState(skipPartiallyExpanded=true) plus BackHandler, commit 8b5f26b; compile and device tests pending. These are not verified fixes. No changes to VPN transport or upload SDK in this batch.

2026-10-08 USER UI FINDINGS AND FIXES: User demonstrated upload video bubble expands near full screen while completed identical video retains natural smaller width. Root cause found: TimelineItemEventRow passed allowFullContentWidth = uploadBubbleMinWidth != null, forcibly enabling full-width behavior during uploads. Commit 7f7da96 explicitly disables allowFullContentWidth for this case while retaining conditional minimum width sized to measured one-line status. Must verify on phone that this doesn't regress legitimate narrow attachments. In RoomListContextMenu, Favorite moved under Tags heading (Tags always shown even without custom tags); room menu uses rememberModalBottomSheetState(skipPartiallyExpanded=true), commit 4de66f. New custom tags no longer auto-activate on creation, commit 0523782. APK artifact is ARM64-only (Poco F3), and full build checkpoint TXT must accompany it. No network/SDK changes in this batch. UI runtime behavior awaits device test.

2026-10-08 RELEASE 125 FOLLOW-UP: User tested run #125 SHA 1589872a75e686ff5ad453576321e0cf1e916f38 and confirms upload behavior and progress/bubble width generally satisfactory; DO NOT regress them while user continues testing. Three targeted changes only: commit 10f3da9c forces uncaptioned file attachment header content to fill wider bubble and align to leading edge; commit 9d22cd56 removes explicit expansion of message action sheet so opening effect matches tag/room context sheet (both skip partial anchor); commit 3a47a2c7 navigates into chat without up-to-50ms getJoinedRoom check, room loads within RoomFlowNode. All require compile/on-device validation. Output ARM64 GplayRelease APK only with per-build checkpoint, no Universal download. No changes to upload transport or VPN in this batch.
